WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    AVG(t.amount) as account_avg
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency
),
frequency_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(account_avg) as freq_avg
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT 
  aa.account_id,
  aa.frequency,
  aa.account_avg,
  aa.account_avg / fa.freq_avg as ratio
FROM account_avgs aa
LEFT JOIN frequency_avgs fa ON aa.frequency = fa.frequency
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
